incident_summary: Prior Q3 lot LOT-840A from Apex Fab #2 exhibited 15.2% solder-void failure while ERP showed SHIPPED_ON_TIME.
learned_rule: Never trust Apex Wafer Corp EDI ASN status alone when a split air/ocean shipment occurs; always cross-verify WMS physical receipt and split sub-lot X-ray acoustic logs before rejecting the entire lot.

incident_summary: Emergency 48-hour air charter from Silicore Dresden covered 2,000-unit SiC module deficit on Line-B with 0.0% incoming rejection.
learned_rule: When Line-B runway drops below 40 hours on SIC-MOD-1200V, split emergency allocation between Silicore Dresden (up to 2,400 units, 2-day air lead) and Pacific Semi Foundry (overflow) to prevent $64,000/hr line-stop.

incident_summary: LFP prismatic cells exposed to >40C for >6 hours showed >5% DCIR increase and failed automotive cycle warranty.
learned_rule: Any LFP-CELL-280AH pallet with transit logger temperature >40C AND DCIR rise >5% must be blocked from EV Line-A and reallocated to stationary BESS grade.
